WORKBOOK 15-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (65-bet, PDF 63). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Surf the Net!' va to'q sariq '15'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Reading':
13a) 'Read the article about teleworking and match the topic sentences to the paragraphs, then underline the correct linking words/phrases in bold.' Mavzu gaplari: a) On the other hand, teleworking has a few disadvantages. b) In conclusion, I believe that teleworking will change the way we work in the future. c) Teleworking is a fresh and new type of employment. d) Working from home has many advantages. Maqola 'The Pros and Cons of Teleworking': [1 __] It allows people to work from home using their telephones, modems and computers and communicating with their employer and co-workers through the Internet. Teleworking can make the way we work easier and less stressful, but/in conclusion at the same time, it can cause several problems. [2 __] However/Firstly, it allows employees to work in the relaxed atmosphere of their homes. This means that they can plan their working day in a more productive and convenient way. Also/In conclusion, teleworking is less time-consuming. People do not need to commute to their jobs and, as a result, they have more time to work effectively. For example/Finally, teleworking can have a positive effect on the environment. If people in large cities work from home and stop using cars and buses, there will be less traffic and therefore less pollution. [3 __] For example/But, some employees find it difficult to concentrate at home. This problem actually makes their work harder and more stressful. However/What is more, people who work at home may feel lonely at times, because they are not involved in the everyday life of an office. This can lead to unhappiness and boredom. [4 __] It may have a few disadvantages, but I believe it not only offers people the opportunity to work in a new and original way, but it benefits our environment too.
13b) 'Match the paragraphs to the headings.' sum up pros & cons ......; state the topic ......; points against ......; points for ......
13c) 'Which good points does the writer mention about teleworking? How does he explain each?'
13d) 'Which bad points does the writer mention about teleworking? How does he explain each?'

O'NG USTUN - 'Writing (a for-and-against essay)':
14) 'Match the viewpoints in column A to their explanations in column B. Then, read the topic sentences in the box below and decide which a) introduces the main topic, b) introduces points for, c) introduces points against, and d) sums up the topic.' A: 1 Computers can do certain tasks much faster than people. 2 Computers don't make mistakes. 3 Computers don't need to be paid for the work they do. 4 In many industries, computers may replace people altogether. 5 Computers do not have personalities or feelings. B: A As a result, employers can reduce their workers' workload and increase their wages. B This could lead to high unemployment. C This means that they can do the time-consuming tasks while workers concentrate on other tasks. D This means that they can't judge people's characters or help people with emotional problems. E Therefore they can be used to help workers such as air-traffic controllers or surgeons whose work is dangerous or demanding. 'Topic Sentences': 1 On the other hand, using computers in the workplace also has disadvantages. 2 In the last few years computers have become a part of almost everybody's everyday lives - especially in the workplace. 3 In conclusion, I believe that using computers in the workplace has both positive and negative points. 4 Using computers in the workplace offers many advantages.
15) 'Use the information from Ex. 14 to write a for-and-against essay entitled "The Advantages and Disadvantages of Computers in the Workplace" (100 - 160 words). Use the article in Ex. 13 as a model.'

structure.modelEn: In the last few years computers have become a part of almost everybody's everyday lives - especially in the workplace. They can make our work easier, but at the same time they can cause some problems.
structure.modelUz: So'nggi yillarda kompyuterlar deyarli har kimning kundalik hayotining bir qismiga aylandi - ayniqsa ish joyida. Ular ishimizni osonlashtirishi mumkin, lekin ayni paytda ba'zi muammolar keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

structure.modelEn: Using computers in the workplace offers many advantages. Firstly, computers can do certain tasks much faster than people. This means that they can do the time-consuming tasks while workers concentrate on other tasks. Also, computers don't make mistakes, so they can be used to help workers such as air-traffic controllers or surgeons whose work is dangerous or demanding. Finally, computers don't need to be paid for the work they do. As a result, employers can reduce their workers' workload and increase their wages.

Bu ular ko'p vaqt oladigan vazifalarni bajarishi, xodimlar esa boshqa ishlarga e'tibor qaratishi mumkinligini bildiradi. Shuningdek, kompyuterlar xato qilmaydi, shuning uchun ular aviadispetcher yoki jarroh kabi ishi xavfli yoki mas'uliyatli xodimlarga yordam berishda ishlatilishi mumkin. Nihoyat, kompyuterlar qilgan ishi uchun maosh talab qilmaydi. Natijada ish beruvchilar xodimlar ish yukini kamaytirib, maoshini oshirishi mumkin.

structure.modelEn: On the other hand, using computers in the workplace also has disadvantages. In many industries, computers may replace people altogether. This could lead to high unemployment. What is more, computers do not have personalities or feelings. This means that they can't judge people's characters or help people with emotional problems.
structure.modelUz: Boshqa tomondan, ish joyida kompyuter ishlatishning kamchiliklari ham bor. Ko'p sohalarda kompyuterlar odamlarni butunlay almashtirishi mumkin. Bu yuqori ishsizlikka olib kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, kompyuterlarda shaxsiyat yoki his-tuyg'u yo'q. Bu ular odamlar xarakterini baholay olmasligi yoki hissiy muammolarda yordam bera olmasligini bildiradi.

structure.modelEn: In conclusion, I believe that using computers in the workplace has both positive and negative points. They may take some jobs away from people, but they help us work faster and more safely.

modelAnswers: The Advantages and Disadvantages of Computers in the Workplace

In the last few years computers have become a part of almost everybody's everyday lives - especially in the workplace. They can make our work easier, but at the same time they can cause some problems.

Using computers in the workplace offers many advantages. Firstly, computers can do certain tasks much faster than people. This means that they can do the time-consuming tasks while workers concentrate on other tasks. Also, computers don't make mistakes, so they can be used to help workers such as air-traffic controllers or surgeons whose work is dangerous or demanding. Finally, computers don't need to be paid for the work they do. As a result, employers can reduce their workers' workload and increase their wages.

On the other hand, using computers in the workplace also has disadvantages. In many industries, computers may replace people altogether. This could lead to high unemployment. What is more, computers do not have personalities or feelings. This means that they can't judge people's characters or help people with emotional problems.
In conclusion, I believe that using computers in the workplace has both positive and negative points. They may take some jobs away from people, but they help us work faster and more safely.
modelAnswersUz: Ish joyida kompyuterlarning afzallik va kamchiliklari

So'nggi yillarda kompyuterlar deyarli har kimning kundalik hayotining bir qismiga aylandi - ayniqsa ish joyida. Ular ishimizni osonlashtirishi mumkin, lekin ayni paytda ba'zi muammolar keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

Ish joyida kompyuter ishlatish ko'p afzalliklar beradi. Birinchidan, kompyuterlar ba'zi vazifalarni odamlardan ancha tez bajaradi. Bu ular ko'p vaqt oladigan vazifalarni bajarishi, xodimlar esa boshqa ishlarga e'tibor qaratishi mumkinligini bildiradi. Shuningdek, kompyuterlar xato qilmaydi, shuning uchun ular aviadispetcher yoki jarroh kabi ishi xavfli yoki mas'uliyatli xodimlarga yordam berishda ishlatilishi mumkin. Nihoyat, kompyuterlar qilgan ishi uchun maosh talab qilmaydi. Natijada ish beruvchilar xodimlar ish yukini kamaytirib, maoshini oshirishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, ish joyida kompyuter ishlatishning kamchiliklari ham bor. Ko'p sohalarda kompyuterlar odamlarni butunlay almashtirishi mumkin. Bu yuqori ishsizlikka olib kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, kompyuterlarda shaxsiyat yoki his-tuyg'u yo'q. Bu ular odamlar xarakterini baholay olmasligi yoki hissiy muammolarda yordam bera olmasligini bildiradi.

Xulosa qilib, ish joyida kompyuter ishlatishning ham ijobiy, ham salbiy tomonlari bor deb hisoblayman. Ular ba'zi ish o'rinlarini odamlardan tortib olishi mumkin, lekin tezroq va xavfsizroq ishlashimizga yordam beradi.
